title: MZ Immunities do not work with the Elements and Status Menu Core (VisuStella)

posts.author: NessTor
posts.body:
Hi, so in my project I wanted the earth element to be completely immune to electric attacks. Something I could do without this plugin, but I used it for convenience (of course, without actually having the earth element, just being immune to electric attacks).
The thing is, I've noticed that while there is a reduction, there's always a minimum amount of damage. Which I don't want.
I already tried removing the element core and setting the damage to 0% in vanilla, and then the damage was 0.
So... I tried using the notetags to reduce damage of all types (flat, rate, and plus), both individually and all three together, using the weakness manager within the plugin, and using the base element rate from RPG Maker. And it ALWAYS stays at the same number.
I also tried downloading the plugin again, in case I accidentally changed something I shouldn't have, and reverting to the base settings, but it's still the same, so I guess this is normal for the plugin?
I even tried changing something here, but I don't know much about it. Does anyone with this plugin have immune enemies? Or can anyone tell me what I can change?

just to explain it a little, the default formula is:
Code:
(base + plus) * rate + flat
Increasing plus works fine if the target's element rate is 100%, but since the plus is added to the base, it stops being accurate in every other scenario.
A target with 0% base takes 50% of the base damage as that's 0% +50%. Another electric type that should only take half damage from electric would take full damage from STAB as it's 50% + 50% instead of 50% * 150% = 75%, while something like Gyarados that'd have a 400% base would have an effective 450% element rate on STABs instead of 600%.
What you wanted was a multiplicative factor, which was already provided by rate.
